title: Two stores, same product. Why one wins.
caption: Same product. Same supplier. One store wins every time. 3 rounds: headline, proof, offer. Plus the prompt to score your own store. #ecommerce #shopifytips #conversionrate #aitools

beats.headline: Same product. | *Different* sales.
beats.say: *Two* stores. Same product. One sells way more. Here's exactly why.

beats.headline: Score your *store*
beats.say: I'll score them in three rounds, then give you the *prompt* to score yours.

beats.headline: Same supplier. | *Different* results.
beats.say: [sigh] Same supplier. Same price. Totally different *results.*

beats.headline: The last one | decides the *sale.*
beats.say: Three rounds. The last one decides the *sale.*
Round one, the headline. Store A says premium posture support. *Store* B says stand straighter in fourteen days. A sells the thing. B *sells* the result.
Round two, proof. Store A has four reviews hidden at the bottom. *Store* B shows a customer video before you even *scroll.*
[surprise-oh] Round three, the offer. Store A is just a price. *Store* B has a two-pack bundle and a thirty-day guarantee. B *removed* the risk.
Final score. Headline, proof, offer. Three to zero. And B's product isn't even *better.*

visual.prompt: Here are 2 product pages: mine and a competitor's. Score headline, proof and offer. Who wins each round? Give fixes.

beats.say: Now score yours. *Paste* your product page and a competitor's into any AI. Then ask: who wins each round, and what's the exact fix?

beats.headline: Better *pitch*, | not product.
beats.say: B doesn't have a better product. B has a better *pitch.*

beats.label: Score your store
beats.headline: Follow for *more*
beats.say: *Save* this, score your store tonight, and follow for more teardowns.
